title: Fresh Lime Posset
summary: A fresh, sharp lime posset with a soft creamy set, finished with green lime zest.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
finely grated lime zest, to decorate

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: put the cream, sugar, 1 tbsp zest and salt in the pan, bring to the boil and keep at a steady boil, stirring often, 6-8 min, until reduced to about 480 ml. Reduced cream sets firmer when the juice goes in.

steps.title: Lime juice
steps.text: take off the heat and stir in the lime juice.

steps.title: Rest and strain
steps.text: leave 20 min until a skin starts to form, then pass through the sieve into the jug. Straining removes the zest for a smooth texture.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: pour into the bowls and refrigerate at least 3 h, until softly set.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: scatter with the fresh zest and add a lime wedge; let stand 10 min before serving. A short rest softens the set.

tips: A common mistake is boiling it over; use a large pan and lift it off the heat if the cream rises.
Roll the limes on the worktop before juicing to get more juice.
Grate the decorating zest at the last moment so it stays bright green.
storage: Cover once set and keep in the fridge for up to 2 days.
